XECH Magneto II XL Table & Floor Lamp – Smart, Stylish & Energy Efficient Lighting

The XECH Magneto II XL Table & Floor Lamp, Single Touch Sensor, Neodymium magnet, Glare-Free Lighting, Energy Efficient LEDs, USB C Charging is a premium modern lighting solution designed for homes, offices, and creative spaces. Built with innovation and elegance in mind, this versatile lamp seamlessly transforms from a table lamp to a floor lamp, delivering superior illumination without compromising on aesthetics or comfort.

Crafted using a powerful neodymium magnet, the Magneto II XL offers effortless attachment and repositioning, making it ideal for flexible lighting needs. Whether you need focused task lighting, ambient mood lighting, or glare-free illumination for reading and working, this lamp adapts instantly to your lifestyle.

Smart Touch Control with Adjustable Brightness

The intuitive single touch sensor lamp technology allows you to control brightness levels with a simple tap. Designed for convenience and modern living, the touch control eliminates the need for switches, creating a clean and minimal look. Adjust light intensity effortlessly to suit reading, studying, working, or relaxing.

Thanks to advanced glare-free lighting, the XECH Magneto II XL reduces eye strain and provides uniform illumination, making it a perfect desk lamp for long working hours or bedside use.

Energy Efficient LED Lighting

Featuring energy efficient LEDs, this consumes significantly less power while delivering bright and consistent lighting. The long-lasting LED technology ensures durability, reduced electricity bills, and minimal environmental impact. This makes the Magneto II XL an excellent choice for eco-conscious users looking for sustainable lighting solutions. The LED light output is carefully calibrated to provide natural illumination, enhancing focus and comfort without harsh shadows or flicker.

USB C Charging for Modern Convenience

Equipped with USB C charging, the Magneto II XL ensures faster and more reliable power delivery. The rechargeable design allows cordless operation, making it easy to move the between rooms without being tied to a power outlet. This feature adds portability and flexibility, ideal for modern homes and workspaces.

Versatile Table & Floor Lamp Design

The innovative design allows this product to function as both a and a offering exceptional versatility. Use it as a desk for focused work, a bedside for nighttime reading, or a stylish to enhance your living room ambiance. Its sleek, contemporary build complements modern interiors, making it a perfect lighting accessory for bedrooms, offices, studios, and lounges.
